A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Molmo2 research and contain complete main text and Appendices A–I. Full text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching of the methods, results, figures, tables, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v2 reports original Molmo2 benchmark evaluations, human-preference results, ablations, and supplementary experiments in Sections 4 and Appendices C–E.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and reports corrected image-pointing scores in Table 7.

M1.justification: The architecture, three-stage training, token weighting, packing, message trees, pointing/tracking procedures, and Appendix E SlowFast variants are unchanged.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is unchanged across video, image, multi-image, grounding, and NLP tasks. No datasets or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout, including Table 7's Poivre-7B, VisionReasoner-7B, Qwen, Gemini, and earlier Molmo models.

E3.justification: No evaluation settings, splits, metrics, budgets, or testing protocols are revised in the text. The new Table 7 footnote identifies an evaluation bug but does not specify a protocol change.

E4.justification: The ablations in Tables 8–11 and 18, counting breakdowns, Appendix E scaling/SlowFast analyses, and qualitative failure cases are retained unchanged. Table 18's Point-Bench ablation scores are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including Appendix C's 1,000-round bootstrap estimation of Elo ratings and confidence intervals in Figure 5. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: Table 7 corrects all three Molmo2 rows downward: average scores change from 71.9 to 67.7 for 4B, 72.7 to 68.7 for 8B, and 70.9 to 66.5 for O-7B. O-7B consequently falls below Poivre-7B's unchanged 67.5, while 8B remains ahead. These corrections are confined to this benchmark; other results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions and formulations, including token weighting, evaluation metrics, and Appendix B's packing objective, are unchanged. No theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims. Section 4.3 also retains its claim that Molmo2 surpasses other Point-Bench models despite the corrected margins.

C2.justification: The new Table 7 footnote explicitly attributes earlier higher scores to an evaluation bug, qualifying their reliability. Explanations of Molmo2's advantages and the limitations in Appendix H remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, data-processing instructions, and resource-access information are unchanged. The bug acknowledgement supplies no technical diagnosis or correction procedure; appendix footnotes are merely renumbered.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and substantive positioning against prior research are unchanged. Related-work text only shifts across page boundaries.

P1.justification: v4 adds an equal-contribution marker for Jae Sung Park and the short evaluation-bug footnote, and updates the version/date header. The narrative and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 7 gains a caption footnote, causing modest text and table reflow across pages 12–15 and subsequent footnote renumbering. v4 also introduces a stray footnote on page 14. Figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 improves reporting reliability by correcting inflated Point-Bench scores and acknowledging the evaluation bug. The correction narrows Molmo2-8B's lead over Poivre-7B from 5.2 to 1.2 points without changing the leading model. This is a limited transparency improvement: the bug's technical cause and fix remain unexplained, and the remaining scientific content is unchanged.
